answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ember of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the inlet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
